status: Bounded no-training diagnostic comparison after passing preregistered numeric feasibility; never automatic promotion
hypothesis: Among four actual audio candidates from the earlier Italian-stable prior, unimodal frozen image/audio compatibility may select more grounded speech without a transcript. Joint image/audio cosine is not used as a critic.
checkpoint_choice: Existing E7 blind notes report stable Italian for this prior/adapter; no choice based on new reranking outputs. All weights unchanged.
scope: Four original exposed development cases plus four prespecified cases from the existing55 development images, one per remaining scene category. None of the96 reserved fresh images is accessed or newly annotated.
null_generation: Four additional candidates from exact semantic zero, not affine image zero. Their selection using each real image is an explicit diagnostic, not an accepted image-conditioned generator.
eligibility: No extra attempts. Empty or frame-capped candidates are recorded and excluded from semantic selection. First/random baselines retain a failure if their single fixed candidate is invalid. No ASR or text-based quality filter.
human_review: Blinded28 pairs: eight images times first/random/image-audio-max, plus shuffled-scorer controls for the four original development cases. Keep duplicate selections; do not select only apparent wins. Scores/narrative quality are human only.
gates: No trained critic, temporal corpus or reader training. If all candidates are unintelligible, reranking is not a solution. Internal cosine improvement is tautological and not a quality result. Await blind listening before any promotion.
